parsed.note_claim: Vaping does not cause popcorn lung, and diacetyl is banned in regulated e-liquids.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: No, vaping does not cause "popcorn lung"... Diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke, but it is banned as an ingredient in UK-regulated nicotine vapes and e-liquids.
parsed.reason: The NHS page directly states both claims in the note.
